existing_features.title: Add all missing static image assets referenced by the frontend into the repository under the frontend public assets folder structure (including /assets and /assets/generated) so that a fresh MCP download includes them and the site renders without broken images.

Audit and fix all frontend image references to ensure they use correct absolute public paths (e.g., /assets/... or /assets/generated/...) and do not depend on any external/temporary URLs; update any incorrect paths so images load in both local dev and production builds.

Add a lightweight frontend-only validation/check during development (documentation or a simple developer note/utility) that lists the required static asset paths used by the app to prevent future missing-asset exports.
